Name: Guided Rounds v1.9.17
Description: 把 P-92 法令手枪的原版制导移植到武器清单里的每一把枪上：弹丸出膛后自动追踪敌人，伤害和初速保持武器原本的数值。带索敌范围圆环、目标锁定标记与方框，全部参数可在游戏内 MODS 菜单实时调整。需要 Bingus Shared Loader v15+；HD2Runtime 可选：每台装了本 mod 的机器由内置装载器自己加载弹丸资源包，装了的 runtime 只额外用来把包同步给大厅。v1.8.1 是代码健壮性与可读性优化（玩法与 v1.8.0 一致，另修掉四处会报错的隐患）；v1.8.2 修掉锁定目标方框在切换武器后残留的问题。v1.9.0 枪械按类型分页、瞄准优先级按阵营分页，并移除无敌的认知干扰器本体。v1.9.11 修好单枪优先级按手上的枪取表、自定义未指向该枪、换枪后模式滞后，以及 0 视作未设置。v1.9.12 修好个别光能族（尤其无票者）锁不上：死亡缓存只认 status=2，无票者的衰减宪法值不再把活体锁出候选；全零骨骼视为读不到。v1.9.13 把弹丸材质加载内置。v1.9.14 修好组队时队友看到粉色问号：内置装载器等游戏启动后再证明并请求，启动期失败不再永久禁用；装了 HD2Runtime 优先交给它（队友同步材质），拒收时自动回退内置装载器。v1.9.15 把内置材质加载改为每台机器自己负责：HD2Runtime 仅额外同步大厅，全队装 mod 时不再出现粉色问号。v1.9.16 支持 Scope of Authority 与 Stratagem Compendium 新增的武器：R-40 Sightliner、P-44 Mist、AMW-20 Apex、LAS-44 Nova、EAT-77/40/23，旧 cfg 第一次启动时自动补进 weapons=。v1.9.17 修好组队粉问号：内置装载器从第一帧就请求弹丸资源包，不再等 20 秒，全队都装本 mod 时开打前包已驻留。|  Guided rounds ported from the P-92 Warrant to every weapon on the list, with an aim-cone range ring, a lock marker and a target box, all tunable from the in-game MODS tab. Requires Bingus Shared Loader v15+; HD2Runtime is optional (only asked to sync the packages to the lobby; every machine with the mod loads them locally). v1.8.1 is a robustness and readability pass (gameplay unchanged from v1.8.0, plus four latent crash fixes); v1.8.2 fixes the lock target box that stayed on screen after a weapon switch. v1.9.0 groups weapons by class and splits manual priority by faction. v1.9.11 fixes per-weapon priority reading the weapon in hand, CUSTOM not arming that weapon's table, a stale mode after a weapon switch, and 0 meaning unset. v1.9.12 fixes Illuminate units (Voteless most of all) that could not be locked: only status=2 (the real death mark) condemns a unit; all-zero bones are unreadable. v1.9.13 loads projectile materials without a mandatory runtime. v1.9.14 fixes the pink question mark clients saw: the built-in loader waits for the game to start before proving/requesting, boot-time failures no longer disable it for the session, an installed HD2Runtime is only asked to sync the packages to the lobby, and the built-in loader always runs on every machine. v1.9.15 makes the built-in loader always run locally and leaves HD2Runtime to sync the lobby, so a squad all running the mod no longer sees a pink question mark. v1.9.16 adds the weapons from Scope of Authority and Stratagem Compendium (R-40 Sightliner, P-44 Mist, AMW-20 Apex, LAS-44 Nova, EAT-77/40/23) to the catalog and appends them to weapons= once for an older cfg. v1.9.17 fixes the squad pink question mark: the built-in loader asks for the packages on the first frame instead of after 20 s, so they are resident before the first shot on every machine that runs the mod.
